# DOT Hazmat Training: General Awareness, Shipper Certification & Supervisor

> DOT Hazmat Training: 5 self-paced online courses from $99.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness Training](https://dot-hazmat.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-152): $99.99 per person, 4 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months.
